name: workspace_search
description: Search Google Drive, Gmail and Calendar with one query and get a merged, date-sorted result list. Use it for 'find everything about X' questions before falling back to per-service tools.

sources.description: Comma-separated sources to search: drive, gmail, calendar

calendar_days_back.description: Calendar only: how far back to search

calendar_days_ahead.description: Calendar only: how far ahead to search

name: digest
description: Composite: one digest across Gmail, Calendar and Drive for the last N hours. Returns text by default, or creates a Google Doc.

sources.description: Comma-separated subset of gmail, calendar, drive

name: compare_tables
description: Composite: diff two ranges by a key column (added / removed / changed rows). Works across sheets or spreadsheets.
